RIBEs initiated by microbeam targeting of the pharynx or rectal valves contribute to RAR, and the RAR of C. elegan s vulval cells can be initiated by microbeam or gamma irradiation of any other cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RAR and RIBEs can be initiated by local irradiation of C. elegan s, and their interaction in the context of a whole organism is mediated by the DNA damage checkpoint.
RAR of vulval cells in C. elegan is induced by RIBE in a cell non-autonomous manner.
the DNA damage response is a major contributor to the interaction of RAR and RIB, which is consistent with the hypothesis that RIB is an important mechanism underlying RAR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the DNA damage response plays a unique role in the interaction between RIBE and RAR in C. elegants.
the DNA damage response, in particular, the DNA damage checkpoint plays an essential role in the induction of both the RIBE initiated and the RAR of C. elegan vulva.
the RAR of the vulva in C elegans is initiated by a bystander signal that is generated by DNA damage checkpoint activation in the irradiated vulval cells.
